messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Synthetic probe failed: prod/kv-canary (12 failures in 5m). Auto-paging #eng-oncall. Dash: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/canary/prod/kv-canary

Maria L.: ack — taking this. Opening the runbook and checking probe traces now.

Jon A.: I'm on standby to help with routing/failover if we need it. Which region is flapping?

Maria L.: looks like US-WEST. Gateway returning a lot of 502s when talking to the model pool. Affects only ~4-6% of production queries hitting that path.

Simona C.: any infra changes around the timestamp? I saw a small kernel update landed overnight on some west nodes.

Maria L.: yeah, kernel rollout started ~02:10 UTC and finished ~02:12 on the west pool. Rollout page shows node subset upgraded to v5.17.2.

Ryan K.: @ops-bot can you pull node health and network stats for west pool? Need GPU mem, kernel versions, and recent reboots.

ops-bot: Fetching node snapshot...
ops-bot: Summary: 3/24 nodes rebooted recently; kernel versions: 3 nodes v5.17.2, rest v5.16.9. No obvious OOMs. Network shows increased retransmits/RTOs on connections between gateway and pool starting 02:08.

Jon A.: Given customer impact potential we should fail traffic to east until we have confidence. Do we have capacity?

Maria L.: we have spare capacity in east. I'll enable regional routing fallback for read requests to reduce 502s.

Maria L.: (1m) regional fallback enabled. Metrics: 5xx rate drops toward baseline in ~90s. Note: the canary continues to fail because it targets west explicitly.

Simona C.: yeah that keeps firing the alert. We should pause west-targeted canaries during routing failovers to avoid noise.

Maria L.: agreed. Pausing canary for west-only check now.

incident-bot: Canary paused by Maria L. — reason: routing fallback active during incident.

Jon A.: confirmed customer-facing errors almost eliminated after fallback. I'll collect gateway logs and correlate to the kernel change.

Maria L.: quick hypothesis: the kernel update induced transient connection churn; with the canary running every 30s and threshold at 3 failures/2m we get rapid pages (false positives).

Simona C.: 30s probe interval + low failure threshold is aggressive for cross-node transient churn. We should make probes more robust.

Ryan K.: quick mitigation options: increase probe interval to 60s, require 5 consecutive failures in a 5m window, add a secondary /health check to triage before paging. Also consider backoff between retries.

Maria L.: let's do a hotfix to the probe config now to stop noise, and then create a follow-up for more durable changes.

Jon A.: applying change in staging now. Will run a few cycles, then push to prod if green.

--- code block ---
# prod/kv-canary probe config (hotfix)
frequency: 60s
failure_threshold:
  consecutive: 5
  window: 300s
secondary_checks:
  - url: "https://gateway-west.internal/health"
    expected_status: 200
backoff_on_fail: 30s
--- end code block ---

Jon A.: staging runs look stable with the new config. Rolling patch to prod in 30s.

Jon A.: prod patch applied. Monitoring results: 0 failures in the last 5m after patch. Gateway 5xx normalized across regions.

Maria L.: unpausing west canary now with updated settings.

incident-bot: Canary resumed (prod/kv-canary) — new config active.

Simona C.: follow-ups I recommend: (1) dashboard panel correlating canary consecutive-failures with kernel/rollout events, (2) change paging rule to require canary + 5xx rate >0.5% for 3m before paging, (3) add synthetic latency checks (p50/p95) for the KV path.

Maria L.: creating post-incident ticket with owners and actions. Immediate mitigations: regional failover + probe tuning. Long-term: rollout gating and better observability.

ops-bot: Created ticket INC-3247: "prod/kv-canary false-positive reduction" — assignees: Simona C., Jon A.; due: 7 days.

Maria L.: handing off on-call to Jon A. — stepping off in 20m but available on pager if anything flares.

Jon A.: taking handoff, acknowledged.

Simona C.: I'll draft the dashboard PR and add annotations for rollout times. Also will propose automation to auto-pause region-specific canaries during region-level failovers.

Maria L.: runbook note: update probe config section and add guidance: "Avoid paging on single-region canary failures without correlated 5xx spike or cross-region corroboration."

Maria L.: incident closed. Root cause: likely kernel rollout causing transient network errors; amplification due to probe sensitivity. Remediation: routing fallback, canary tuning, follow-up for rollout policy. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:

Ryan K.: pinging eng-sre and product to review follow-up actions for rollout gating.
